doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Hotel engagements in Paris, Boston and New York
summary: She worked the Meridien in Paris, the Copley Plaza in Boston and the Sheridan in New York.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: How about hotels? Did the hotel gigs either open up or were they consistent through your career?
I had some, like the Meridien Hotel in Paris. I worked the Copley Plaza in Boston. Then I worked the Sheridan in New York. That was not too long.
